title: Cannot install chart on private Artifactory registry with self-signed cert

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Categorizes issue or PR as related to a bug.

body:
We are using the Artifactory Helm plugin on Artifactory version `6.13.1`. When installing a chart in a repository via `helm install`, the following error occurs:

```shell
» helm install --generate-name helm-virtual/foo
Error: failed to download "helm-virtual/foo" (hint: running `helm repo update` may help)
```
This repository was added with a specified CA file:

```shell
» helm repo add helm-virtual $ARTIFACTORY_URL/artifactory/helm-virtual --username $USER --password $PASS --ca-file=/tmp/artifactory.crt
"helm-virtual" has been added to your repositories
```

This is confirmed by checking `~/.helm/repository/repositories.yaml`.

By changing the following to be hard coded, I can get past this error: 
```diff
diff --git a/pkg/getter/httpgetter.go b/pkg/getter/httpgetter.go
index 89abfb1c..f19196dd 100644
--- a/pkg/getter/httpgetter.go
+++ b/pkg/getter/httpgetter.go
@@ -89,8 +89,8 @@ func NewHTTPGetter(options ...Option) (Getter, error) {
 }

 func (g *HTTPGetter) httpClient() (*http.Client, error) {
-       if (g.opts.certFile != "" && g.opts.keyFile != "") || g.opts.caFile != "" {
-               tlsConf, err := tlsutil.NewClientTLS(g.opts.certFile, g.opts.keyFile, g.opts.caFile)
+       if true {
+               tlsConf, err := tlsutil.NewClientTLS(g.opts.certFile, g.opts.keyFile, "/tmp/artifactory.crt")
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "can't create TLS config for client")
                }
```

Output of `helm version`:
```
» helm version
version.BuildInfo{Version:"v3.0.0", GitCommit:"e29ce2a54e96cd02ccfce88bee4f58bb6e2a28b6", GitTreeState:"clean", GoVersion:"go1.13.4"}
```
